269.csv::7.source_text:
覚者さま、巨人《ヨトン》討伐の件
お引き受けくださりありがとうございます
269.csv::7.translated_text:
Ser Arisen, thank you for accepting the
subjugation of the Giant Jotun.
269.csv::7.speaker: Christine

269.csv::8.source_text:
巨人は数年前、ついに討伐隊により
深手を負い姿を消したのですが――
死には至らず、息をひそめていたのでしょう
269.csv::8.translated_text:
The giants, some years past, were finally dealt
grievous wounds by a subjugation force and
vanished — yet &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twas not death; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis like they
lay dormant, biding their time.
269.csv::8.speaker: Christine

269.csv::9.source_text:
ヨトンは《巨人の寝床》に居るはずです
再びかの魔物を追い払って
いただけないでしょうか
269.csv::9.translated_text:
The Jotun should be in The Giant&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s Bed. Would you
drive that monster off anew?
269.csv::9.speaker: Christine

269.csv::10.source_text:
《ヨトン》討伐、覚者さまのお力あってこそ――
本当にありがとうございました
269.csv::10.translated_text:
The vanquishing of Jotun; &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis only with your
power, Master Arisen, that this was accomplished.
Truly, thank you.
269.csv::10.speaker: Christine

269.csv::11.source_text:
これで白獅子もかの巨人も
再び姿を現したとて、当面この森に
食い止めておくことができましょう
269.csv::11.translated_text:
With this, e&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;en if the White Lion or that giant
were to reappear, we should be able to keep them
at bay in this forest for the time being.
269.csv::11.speaker: Christine

269.csv::12.source_text:
貴方さまは、この森の平穏だけでなく
リンウッドやテルまでお守りになったのです
269.csv::12.translated_text:
You&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve guarded not only this forest&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s peace, but
Lynwood and Tel as well.
269.csv::12.speaker: Christine

269.csv::13.source_text:
森の南部、《巨人の寝床》に現れし
モルトロール《ヨトン》の討伐
どうかよろしくお願いいたします
269.csv::13.translated_text:
The Mole Troll Jotun has appeared in the forest&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s
south — The Giant&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s Bed. Its subjugation... 
I leave it in your hands.
269.csv::13.speaker: Christine

269.csv::14.source_text:
魔物が活発に動き始めれば
いずれリンウッドやテルにまで被害が
出るやもしれません――
269.csv::14.translated_text:
Should monsters begin to stir, harm may well
reach Lynwood and Tel ere long—
269.csv::14.speaker: Christine

269.csv::15.source_text:
やってくれるんだね
ではあらためて説明しておくよ
269.csv::15.translated_text:
You&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll see it done, then? Very well — let
me explain anew.
269.csv::15.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::16.source_text:
退治してほしい魔物は、《神花のテラス》にいる
魔獣、コカトリスさ
269.csv::16.translated_text:
The beast I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;d have you fell is the Cockatrice — a
monster lurking in the Divine Blossom Terrace.
269.csv::16.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::17.source_text:
石化の吐息を吐く、巨大な雄鶏――
かなり厄介な魔物だよ
リングディール一人じゃ手に余っていたんだ
269.csv::17.translated_text:
A gargantuan monster that bears the head of a
cock, with a petrifying breath— quite the
troublesome foe. &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Twas too
much for Ringdeel alone.
269.csv::17.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::18.source_text:
そいつのせいで、あの遺跡を調べられず
やむなく封鎖していたんだけど
君たちなら倒せるんじゃないかと思ってね
269.csv::18.translated_text:
Thanks to that beast, we could not investigate the
ruins — had no choice but to seal them off. But I
thought you might be the one to fell it.
269.csv::18.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::19.source_text: どうかよろしく頼むよ
269.csv::19.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::20.source_text:
《神花のテラス》のコカトリスを
倒してくれたんだね！
ここまで魔獣の断末魔が響いたよ
269.csv::20.translated_text:
You felled the Cockatrice in the Divine Blossom
Terrace! Its death cry echoed all the way hence!
269.csv::20.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::21.source_text:
お陰であの遺跡について調べられそうだ
感謝するよ
269.csv::21.translated_text:
Thanks to you, I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll be able to
investigate those ruins.
I am truly beholden to you.
269.csv::21.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::22.source_text:
実はね、遺跡のどこかにはエルフが滅んだ
もう一つの原因――&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;白い災厄&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;と呼ばれる何かがあるかもしれないんだ文献に度々登場する、エルテ・ディナンの災いさ
269.csv::22.translated_text:
Truth be told, somewhere in the ruins may lie
another cause of the elves&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27; extinction —
something called the &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;White Scourge&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;. The bane of
Erte Deenan, oft spoken of in
the historical records.
269.csv::22.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::23.source_text:
エルフが滅んだ原因は錬金術師のせいだと
言われているけど、どうもそれだけじゃないらしい
僕はどうしてもその災いの正体を確かめたいんだ
269.csv::23.translated_text:
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis said the elves&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27; extinction was the
alchemists&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27; doing, but &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twould seem there&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s more
to it. I needs must uncover the true
nature of that scourge.
269.csv::23.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::24.source_text: 何か分かったら君にも伝えるよ
269.csv::24.translated_text: If I learn aught, I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll let you know.
269.csv::24.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::25.source_text:
やぁ、どうかな？
《神花のテラス》のコカトリスは倒せそうかな
269.csv::25.translated_text:
Hey now — how goes it? Think you can fell the
Cockatrice in the Divine Blossom Terrace?
269.csv::25.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::26.source_text:
僕がリングディールくらい戦えれば
良かったんだけど、どうも戦いは苦手でね
269.csv::26.translated_text:
Would that I could fight like Ringdeel, but
combat&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s e&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er been my weakness.
269.csv::26.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::27.source_text: 悪いけどよろしく頼むよ
269.csv::27.translated_text:
I know this is a bit of a hassle, but I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;d truly
appreciate your help.
269.csv::27.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::28.source_text:
エルテ・ディナンのアーマ区画――
《レ・カルバス・アーマ》の調査
引き受けてくれるのかい？
ありがとう！
269.csv::28.translated_text:
The Arma Section of Erte Deenan — Le Karvas Arma.
You will undertake its investigation? Thank you!
269.csv::28.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::29.source_text:
君が前にコカトリスを倒してくれた
《神花のテラス》で、気になる手記を
発見したんだ
269.csv::29.translated_text:
I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve discovered a journal that gives me pause in
the Divine Blossom Terrace where you
felled the Cockatrice.
269.csv::29.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::30.source_text: 都に降りた&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;白い災厄&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;に貫かれ、残っていたわずかな仲間も命を落としてしまった
269.csv::30.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::31.source_text: 災厄をどうにかアーマの奥に閉じ込めることができたが、もはや都を立て直すことは叶わない――
269.csv::31.translated_text:
Although we managed to somehow seal the calamity
deep within the Arma, rebuilding the capital
is now beyond reach...
269.csv::31.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::32.source_text:
この手記の通りだとすると――
今でもその&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;災厄&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;はアーマ区画にあることになる
269.csv::32.translated_text:
If the journal speaks true — then the &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;calamity&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;
yet dwells in the Arma Section.
269.csv::32.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::33.source_text:
アーマの入り口は、その手記にあった
スペリングで開放しておいた
僕は馬鹿なことをしているのかもしれないけど、
どうか災厄の正体を突き止めてくれ
269.csv::33.translated_text:
The Arma&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s entrance — I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ve opened it with the
chant from that journal. Mayhap I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;m a fool for it
— but pray, uncover the Scourge&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s true nature.
269.csv::33.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::34.translated_text: And, if possible, by your own hand...
269.csv::34.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::35.source_text:
――ありがとう
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;白い災厄&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;を退けてくれたのだな覚者よ――
269.csv::35.translated_text:
―Thank you.
Now that you have driven away the
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;White Scourge,&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot; Arisen...
269.csv::35.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::36.source_text:
これでようやく、無念のまま命を落とした
仲間達を弔うことができた――
269.csv::36.translated_text:
Now at last, I can lay to rest the those comrades
who fell with bitter regret...
269.csv::36.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::38.source_text:
なんだい、僕今何か変な事言ったかな？
ところで、&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;白い災厄&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;の正体は歳経たアングルスだったんだね
269.csv::38.translated_text:
What is it? Did I say summat queer just now?
So, ​the White Scourge was an
aged Angules, was it?
269.csv::38.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::39.source_text:
でも、不思議だよ
正体も分からない、見たこともない
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;白い災厄&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;なんてものを、どうしてここまで僕は調べ消し去りたいと思ったのか
269.csv::39.translated_text:
But &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis strange. I did not e&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;en know what it is,
ne&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er seen it—why did I feel such a strong urge
to investigate and erase the White Scourge?
269.csv::39.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::40.source_text:
なぜかは解らないけど、気分は晴れやかだ
君の力を借りる事ができて
本当に良かったよ
269.csv::40.translated_text:
Can&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t say why, but my spirits are clear.
That I could borrow your
might—truly, a boon sent by the Dragon.
269.csv::40.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::41.source_text: &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;白い災厄&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;quot;が封じられているのはエルテ・ディナンの中にある区画《レ・カルバス・アーマ》だ
269.csv::41.translated_text:
The White Scourge is sealed in the section Le
Karvas Arma, within Erte Deenan.
269.csv::41.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::42.source_text:
どうかそこに向かい、災厄の正体を
突きとめてほしんだ
269.csv::42.translated_text:
I ask that you head there and uncover the
Scourge&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s true nature.
269.csv::42.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::43.source_text:
そして、できるなら君の手で
災厄そのものを――
269.csv::43.translated_text:
And, if you can, by your own
hand—the Scourge itself—
269.csv::43.speaker: Rondejeel

269.csv::44.source_text:
よ、よし！　受けてくれるんだな？
じゃあもうちょっと詳しく説明するぞ
269.csv::44.translated_text:
R-right! You&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll take it on?
Then I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;ll explain in a bit more detail.
269.csv::44.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::45.source_text:
《バートランド墓地》っていうところはな
もともと北部の民の墓だったんだが、
数年前の戦いで、オークと覚者が
籠城戦をした場所でもある
269.csv::45.translated_text:
Betland Cemetery—&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;twas originally a graveyard for
the northern folk, but years past, orcs and
Arisen waged a siege there.
269.csv::45.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::46.source_text:
で、その時に彼らの数人は
内部から墓地を封鎖したんだよ
自分らともども、オークを閉じ込めるために
269.csv::46.translated_text:
And then, several of their number sealed the
cemetery from within—themselves along with
it, to cage the orcs.
269.csv::46.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::47.source_text:
それ以降、封鎖しっぱなしだったわけだが
さすがにそのままってのもな――
で、封鎖を解除することにしたんだ
269.csv::47.translated_text:
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Twas sealed tight e&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;er since, but that can&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t
stand forever—so we decided to release the seal.
269.csv::47.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::48.source_text:
やぁ、何人か声を掛けたんだが
引き受けてくれる奴がいなかったんだよな
269.csv::48.translated_text:
I called out to a few people for help, 
but not a one would take it on.
269.csv::48.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::49.source_text:
――まぁそういうわけなんだ
じゃ、調査と討伐、頼んだからな！
269.csv::49.translated_text:
Well, that&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s the lay of it. Investigation and
extermination—I&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;m counting on you!
269.csv::49.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::50.source_text:
よぉ、お帰り
《バートランド墓地》の調査はどうだった？
269.csv::50.translated_text:
Ho there, welcome back. How went the
investigation of Betland Cemetery?
269.csv::50.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::51.source_text:
――ほう、そうか
オークの生き残りとトロールがいたのか
269.csv::51.translated_text:
... Hoh, I see. Orc survivors and a
Troll, were there?
269.csv::51.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::52.source_text:
考えたくないが、奴らにとっては
あったってワケだよな
十分な食糧が――
269.csv::52.translated_text:
Hate to think about it, but for them,
it&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;s a given, isn&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;t it?
That there was enough feed...
269.csv::52.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::53.source_text:
ともあれ、ご苦労さん！
この調子なら、オーク軍を後退させて
バートランド平原北部への道を
再整備できるかもしれん
269.csv::53.translated_text:
Be that as it may, goodly work! At this rate,
mayhap we can drive back the orc army and restore
the road to Northern Betland Plains.
269.csv::53.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::54.source_text:
引き続き、この辺りのボードクエストや
ワールドクエストをクリアして
力を貸してくれ！
269.csv::54.translated_text:
Keep clearing Board Quests and World Quests
around these parts, and lend us your strength!
269.csv::54.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::55.source_text:
例のほら、《バートランド墓地》の
調査任務よろしくな
269.csv::55.translated_text:
You know the one—the Betland Cemetery
investigation mission. Counting on you.
269.csv::55.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::56.source_text:
他に重要な任務があるなら
そっちを優先していいからな
269.csv::56.translated_text: If other urgent missions call, answer them first.
269.csv::56.speaker: Scherzo

269.csv::105.source_text:
覚者様、では《黒淵谷》に赴き
ナイトメア《嘆きのモーラ》討伐を
お願い申し上げます
269.csv::105.translated_text:
Ser Arisen, I must ask you to make for Black
Abyss Valley and subjugate the
Nightmare, Wailing Mora.
269.csv::105.speaker: Dian

269.csv::106.source_text: 彼女の叫びは聞く人間の魂を凍らせ　歌は死を呼ぶ――
269.csv::106.translated_text:
Her scream freezes the souls of those who hear;
her song calls forth death—
269.csv::106.speaker: Dian

269.csv::107.source_text:
優れた術を駆使したメルゴダの民をして
そう言わしめたほどの
恐ろしの魔鳥なのです
269.csv::107.translated_text:
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis a fearsome demon bird, to make even the
people of Mergoda, who wielded
supreme arts, speak so.
269.csv::107.speaker: Dian

269.csv::108.source_text:
放置すれば、レスタニアにとって
新たな脅威となること間違いありません
269.csv::108.translated_text:
&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;Tis certain to become a new threat for
Lestania if left unattended.
269.csv::108.speaker: Dian

269.csv::109.source_text:
あの魔獣を倒しうる力をお持ちなのは
私が知る限り、貴方様のみ
269.csv::109.translated_text:
Ser, you alone hold the power to fell
that demon beast.
269.csv::109.speaker: Dian

269.csv::110.source_text: どうか、よろしくお頼み申し上げます
269.csv::110.speaker: Dian

269.csv::111.source_text:
覚者様、《嘆きのモーラ》討伐
お見事でございました
269.csv::111.translated_text:
Ser Arisen, splendid work subduing
that Wailing Mora.
269.csv::111.speaker: Dian

269.csv::112.source_text:
やはり貴方様は、この禁域へ来るべくして
来られたお方
269.csv::112.translated_text:
As I suspected, you are indeed the one who was
destined to come to this forbidden realm.
269.csv::112.speaker: Dian

269.csv::113.source_text:
あなたの従者となれぬ身を悔いますが
この地のエリアマスターこそ
今の我が使命
269.csv::113.translated_text:
I rue that I cannot stand as your follower, yet
Area Master of this land—that is my charge now.
269.csv::113.speaker: Dian

269.csv::114.source_text:
その役割にて、できうる限り
貴方様を支えゆく所存にございます
269.csv::114.translated_text:
In this capacity, &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;#x27;tis my resolve to
support you to the utmost.
269.csv::114.speaker: Dian

269.csv::115.source_text:
覚者様、《黒淵谷》に現れたナイトメア
《嘆きのモーラ》は、レスタニアの
新たな脅威となりえる魔物――
269.csv::115.translated_text:
Ser Arisen, the Nightmare that emerged in Black
Abyss Valley—Wailing Mora—is a monster that may
well become a new threat to Lestania—
269.csv::115.speaker: Dian

269.csv::116.source_text:
かの魔物が他の地へと飛来する前に
どうぞ討伐のほどお頼み申し上げます
269.csv::116.translated_text:
Ere that monster takes wing for other lands, I
beseech you — attend to its extermination.
269.csv::116.speaker: Dian
